info.name: Sanctum API
info.description:
Laravel Sanctum scaffold for this project.

**Routes**
- `GET /api/user` — authenticated user (Bearer personal access token or SPA session).
- `GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie` — starts SPA cookie session (pair with CSRF header on mutating requests).
- `GET /up` — application health.

**Personal access tokens**
There is no token-issuing HTTP route in the default scaffold. Add `Laravel\Sanctum\HasApiTokens` to `App\Models\User`, then create a token (e.g. `php artisan tinker` → `$user->createToken('postman')->plainTextToken`) and paste it into the `sanctum_token` collection variable.

request.description: Sets the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie for first-party SPA authentication. Call this first from a browser-like client, then send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header (and session cookies) on subsequent API requests. For Postman-only testing, personal access tokens are usually simpler.
Defined in `routes/api.php`. Uses `auth:sanctum` middleware. Returns 401 without a valid Bearer token or session.
